Discover ING Hubs Romania
ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals.
We started out in 2015 as ING's software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate from our office in Bucharest.
Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products.
We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged.
For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?
The Mission
Bank Mendes Gans (BMG) is a specialized wholesale bank and a wholly owned subsidiary of ING Group, focused on delivering advanced cash management, liquidity management, and transaction banking solutions to multinational corporations around the world. Combining deep financial expertise with innovative technology, BMG helps global organizations optimize working capital, centralize treasury operations, and manage complex international cash flows efficiently and securely.
BMG serves large multinational companies, international corporate groups, and globally operating enterprises that require sophisticated treasury and liquidity management capabilities. Its customers span a wide range of industries and rely on BMG to provide scalable financial infrastructure that supports their global growth, operational efficiency, and financial resilience.
BMG offers a comprehensive portfolio of treasury and transaction banking services, including cash pooling, in-house banking, intercompany netting, domestic and international payments, virtual account structures, liquidity optimization, financial messaging, and cash visibility solutions. These services enable clients to centralize financial operations, streamline cross-border transactions, reduce operational complexity, optimize liquidity across multiple entities and markets, and gain real-time insight into their global cash positions. Through close integration with ING's global banking network and technology platforms, BMG delivers reliable, scalable, and innovative solutions that support the treasury needs of some of the world's largest and most internationally active organizations.
Your day to day
As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will be a key contributor in a multidisciplinary, self-sufficient squad responsible for designing, building, operating, and continuously improving BMG's global treasury and transaction banking platforms. You will work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, peer DevOps engineers, and business stakeholders to translate complex treasury requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient technology solutions.
Engineering & Delivery
Design, develop, test, and maintain business-critical applications across both frontend and backend components.
Build modern APIs, integration services, and user-facing functionality that support BMG's liquidity and information management solutions.
Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions.
Ensure software is secure, maintainable, scalable, and resilient by design.
Drive continuous improvement of code quality through code reviews, automated testing, refactoring, and engineering best practices.
 Production Ownership ("You Build It, You Run It")
Take ownership of services throughout their entire lifecycle, from development to production operations.
Monitor application health, investigate incidents, troubleshoot production issues, and lead root cause analysis activities.
Improve observability, alerting, reliability, and operational resilience of your services.
Participate in on-call and production support rotations where required.
Continuously reduce operational overhead through automation and self-healing capabilities.
 AI & Engineering Productivity
Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and knowledge discovery.
Apply critical thinking and engineering judgment when using AI-generated outputs.
Contribute to responsible AI adoption by ensuring compliance with ING security, privacy, and governance requirements.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities and improve team productivity through AI-enabled workflows and modern engineering tooling.
 Risk, Governance & Resilience
Ensure adherence to technology governance, risk management, security, DORA, resilience, and compliance requirements.
Continuously improve engineering controls related to security, operational risk, resiliency, disaster recovery, and service continuity.
Ensure teams are audit-ready and maintain appropriate documentation and evidence of compliance.
 Collaboration
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand customer journeys and treasury processes.
Share knowledge, mentor less experienced engineers, and contribute to a strong engineering culture.
Participate actively in squad ceremonies, technical communities, and cross-team initiatives.
Act as a team player, with honesty and openness and foster an environment of mutual trust, accountability and transparency.
 Continuous Improvement
Continuously grow your expertise in software engineering, cloud technologies, integration patterns, DevOps, and financial services.
Challenge existing solutions and propose improvements that increase system quality, customer value, reliability, or engineering efficiency.
Contribute to the evolution of engineering standards, development practices, and platform modernization initiatives.
 What success looks like
You consistently deliver high-quality software with minimal production issues.
Your services are reliable, observable, secure, and cost-effective.
You proactively automate manual work and leverage AI to improve delivery speed and quality.
You act as a technical leader within the squad and help raise the engineering bar for others.
You take ownership beyond coding, understanding both the technology and the treasury business processes that BMG supports.
